name: Inline skate
definition: boot with a single line of wheels in a frame, made for skating.
notes: Inline skates sold as complete, boot-only and pro-model categories

name: Ski goggles
definition: goggles made for skiing and snowboarding against glare, wind and snow (K-125).

name: Ski helmet
definition: helmet made for skiing and snowboarding (K-125).

name: Alpine ski
definition: ski made for downhill skiing with a fixed-heel binding; use class, width and radius are attributes.
notes: Alpine skis category with use groups

name: Ski boot
definition: rigid plastic-shell boot made to drive an alpine or touring ski through the binding; flex index on the maker's scale is an attribute.

name: Cross-country ski
definition: long, narrow ski made for Nordic touring or racing with a free-heel binding.

name: Ice skate
definition: boot with a steel blade made for skating on ice.
notes: Figure skates sold as ice skates

name: Touring ski
definition: light ski made for climbing with skins and descending, used with a touring binding and boot interface (E-16).

name: Snowboard
definition: single wide board ridden sideways down snow with both feet bound to it.

name: Ski bag
definition: bag that carries one pair of skis; a bag for several pieces is A4 (K-137).
notes: Ski bag 'ORIGINAL 1 PAIR 160-210' sold as Unisex Ski Bag

name: Ski binding
definition: binding that fixes a boot to a ski or snowboard and releases it in a fall.

name: Crampon
definition: spiked frame fitted to a boot for grip on ice and hard snow.
notes: Page sells KTS Hiking Crampons; ice-axe-grade crampons not shown

name: Baseball glove
definition: padded leather glove or mitt made for catching in baseball or softball.
notes: Baseball and softball gloves by position and brand

name: Cricket ball
definition: hard, leather-covered cork-core ball with a raised seam, made for cricket.
notes: Kookaburra cricket balls: match, indoor, training

name: Cricket bat
definition: flat-faced willow bat made for cricket; willow grade 1 to 4 is an attribute (a retailer convention).

name: Football
definition: inflated ball made for association football; size is an attribute.

name: Rugby ball
definition: oval inflated ball made for rugby; official-ball class and size are attributes.

name: Competition swimsuit
definition: racing suit made for competitive swimming; bikinis, trunks and beachwear are A1 (K-126).
notes: Racing swimwear kneesuits and jammers, World Aquatics approved

name: Mouthguard
definition: moulded guard worn over the teeth to protect them in contact sports.
